title: GENIE: A Fine-Grained Measure for Novelty
abstract: arXiv:2606.12790v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models have consistently demonstrated a lack of creativity and diversity across tasks. Prior work has focused on addressing whether models are capable of generating creative outputs. Here, we aim to consider novelty and investigate what makes model-generated content novel or not novel in a task-specific manner. We propose a fine-grained evaluation metric GENIE to measure the novelty of responses along task-specific features with respect to a population of responses. We show that unlike GENIE, holistic metrics struggle to capture the high-dimensionality of novelty and do not provide insight on which properties they target. Finally, we use GENIE to measure the effectiveness of mitigation methods that address creativity to better understand where these methods can improve novelty.

translated_title: GENIE：一种细粒度的新颖性度量方法
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在各类任务中持续表现出创造力和多样性的缺乏。以往的工作主要集中于探讨模型是否能够生成有创意的输出。本文中，我们旨在研究新颖性，并以任务特定的方式探究是什么使模型生成的内容具有新颖性或不具有新颖性。我们提出了一种细粒度的评估指标GENIE，用于基于响应群体、沿任务特定特征来衡量响应的新颖性。我们表明，与GENIE不同，整体性指标难以捕捉新颖性的高维特性，并且无法洞察其针对的具体属性。最后，我们使用GENIE来衡量针对创造力的缓解方法的有效性，以更好地理解这些方法可以在哪些方面提升新颖性。
tldr: 本文提出细粒度评估指标GENIE，基于任务特定特征相对于响应群体来衡量模型生成内容的新颖性，克服了整体性指标难以捕捉新颖性高维特性的局限，并可有效评估创造力提升方法的效果。
